findings.title: Stale data file: data/risk_manager_report.json (47h old, threshold 26h)
findings.description: data/risk_manager_report.json has not been updated in 47h. Expected refresh interval: 26h. Data from this file may be leading to decisions based on stale market state.
findings.proposed_fix: Check that the agent producing data/risk_manager_report.json ran successfully in recent logs. Verify its cron schedule is active.
